Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan

Indian Standard 

DIMENSIONS FOR 

CRYSTAL AND DIAL OPENINGS (SHAPED OR CIRCULAR) 

FOR WATCH CASES 



1, Scope — Covers the terminology and dimensions relevant to crystal fitting in bezels of shaped or 
circular dial openings of the following types : 

Type A Grooved type crystal seat in bezel. 

Type B Undercut type crystal seat in bezel. 

2. Terminology — see Fig. 1. 




TYPE A 



a— Dimension of dial opening 

6 — Dimension of dial 

c— Dimension of diai seat 

(/ — Dimension of opening in bezel for cr/stal 

• — Fitting dimension of crystal 

f— Deplhi of groove for crystal seating 

g — Widtii of crystal fiange 

h — Thickness of crystai flange 



TYPE B 



/— Height of crystal seating in bezel 
m — Thicl<ness of crystal seating flange 

In bezel 
n — Width of groove for crystai seating 
p— Width of undercut for crystal seating 
a— Crystai fitting angle In crystal 
P — Crystal seating angle in bezel 
Y —Bevel angle in crystal

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This Standard Is one of a series of Indian Standards relating to wrist watch cases. In the 
preparation of this standard assistance has been derived from NIHS 60-12; 1966 Boites de forme — 
Profils du cran de glace. Normes De L'Industrie Horlogere Suisse.
